Political parties demand audits and FIRs against power companies

The Nayagaon BJP unit has demanded an FIR against the Punjab State Power Corporation Limited for alleged negligence. Separately, the Biju Janata Dal (BJD) has called for a CAG audit into Tata Power's expenditure on infrastructure development. These demands highlight political scrutiny of power utility operations and spending.
